Connected to %1$s %2$s. Changes are saved right away. If an app still behaves the old way, reboot.
Not connected to LSPosed. Enable this module in LSPosed, then reopen this app. Changes can\'t be saved until then.
Connected to LSPosed, but it doesn\'t support module settings. Changes can\'t be saved.
Allow face unlock for all apps

Turn face unlock off for apps that protect data with a biometric key, such as password managers (Aegis, Bitwarden) and banking apps. Face unlock on this device can\'t unlock those keys, so they fail when face is used. With face off, they\'ll offer fingerprint only.\n\nTap an app to switch it. Long-press to make it follow the default again.
